name: vector_light_door_handover_survey
description: SURVEY, not a gate. Reads door_aperture and vanilla's own door_outside_ground_glow on every frame of a door's swing -- OPENING then CLOSING -- so the frame vanilla's light arrives on (and leaves on) can be compared against the frames our polygon parts and rejoins the leaves. Tolerances are deliberately huge: nothing here asserts, the numbers are read out of the report. Run on two builds and diff.

steps.description: ARM A -- THE SHIPPED DEFAULT, all three door flags on. Vanilla's grid opens during this swing, so this is the arm the renderer handover happens in. On the build before the fix the grid opened on the LAST quantisation step and the per-frame brightness curve steps once, near the end; with the fix it opens on the first and the curve is smooth.

ARM B -- THE CONTROL, glow blocker off. Vanilla never delivers past this door at all, so our model owns the render for the whole swing AND at the end of it: one renderer by construction. This is the shape a curve with no handover in it has, which is what makes a step in arm A a handover rather than the torch flickering.
